_about: Pins for the P2-13 suite-vs-suite comparison ONLY. The official suite is compared at CURRENT MAIN (deliberately newer than the signal-pin in conformance/SOURCES.lock.json: a fair head-to-head must face the official suite at its best, including its newest fixes). Regenerate deliberately with fetch_official.sh --repin and re-run the comparison; results/*.md is only valid for the SHAs it records in its own meta block.

official_conformance_suite.note: 9 commits ahead of the SOURCES.lock signal pin f78fe9f1 at comparison time — includes upstream fixes #73-#81 (several of which landed from our own filings) and the new webhook_structure_test module. 78 test methods.

official_python_sdk_sibling.resolve_full_sha_note: python-sdk rides main by necessity (see why); results.json meta records the exact SHA used by each run.
official_python_sdk_sibling.why: the official suite's pyproject takes ucp-sdk as an editable PATH dep from ../python-sdk; current-main tests import modules (reverse_domain_name, error_response) that exist only on python-sdk main, so the sibling must be main, not the 0.3.0 pin.

golden: the flower reference server pinned by conformance/SOURCES.lock.json reference_sample_server — the SAME golden our own CI kill-tests run against; boot with conformance/ci/serve_golden.sh.
